# The fixtures carrying a flat Fern golden (`expected-flat/`): Fern's output for a
# `local-file-system` output path, which crozier reproduces with `layout: flat`.
# Read by scripts/generate-fern-fixture.sh (`--layout flat` refuses an undeclared
# fixture), scripts/fern-goldens (refreshes the flat golden of every listed
# CORPUS.md row beside its packaged one) and tests/e2e.rs (`FLAT_GOLDENS` must
# list exactly these). A flat golden takes its fixture's settings from
# fern-generator-config.txt.
#
# `spec` names the fixture whose vendored openapi.yml the golden generates from,
# or the CORPUS.md row whose source is committed under corpus-sources/, for a
# golden directory with no spec of its own — a second flat golden over an
# already-registered document, differing only by a setting. Empty means the
# fixture's own spec (vendored, or fetched for a CORPUS.md row).
# fixture|spec
swagger-petstore|
swagger-petstore-distribution|swagger-petstore
exhaustive|
client-class-name|
audience-filter-strict|
eos.local-extra-fields-forbid|
exhaustive-package-name|exhaustive
swagger-petstore-organization|swagger-petstore
